name: Maya Rahman
bio: Making a big city feel a little smaller. Happy to talk design, share a neighborhood recommendation, or help you find your footing in NYC.

name: Arif Chowdhury
bio: A Queens local who loves turning ideas into useful things. Ask me about your first tech role, building a website, or the best tea in Jackson Heights.

name: Sofia Martinez
bio: Connecting good people with good causes. I can help you find volunteer opportunities, navigate neighborhood resources, or practice your Spanish.

name: Jin Park
bio: Curious about the spaces we share. Here to meet neighbors, exchange creative ideas, and help demystify a home renovation.

name: Aisha Khan
bio: Your next chapter starts with a conversation. I help early-career New Yorkers tell their story, prepare for interviews, and build confidence.

name: Daniel Okafor
bio: Building a business and a community in Bed-Stuy. Happy to share what I learned opening my first shop, including all the things I wish I knew earlier.

name: Lena Fischer
bio: A Brooklyn transplant with a love for print, public parks, and collaborative projects. Always happy to offer a second pair of eyes on a portfolio.

name: Marcus Williams
bio: Harlem born and raised. Connecting people through music, mentoring, and the occasional pickup basketball game.

name: Mei Chen
bio: Helping neighbors feel more confident with everyday money questions. Here for budgeting tips, community workshops, and a good noodle recommendation.

name: Carlos Rivera
bio: Keeping the Bronx rolling. I can teach you a quick bike fix, help plan a group ride, or point you toward a great neighborhood project.

name: Priya Shah
bio: A Staten Island neighbor who likes making complex things simple. Happy to help with spreadsheets, data projects, or finding a path into analytics.

name: Nadia Ahmed
bio: Language opens doors. I organize friendly conversation practice and help new neighbors feel at home, one small conversation at a time.
